title: Discrete nonempty generization fibres of strict localization
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $x,y\in X$ with $x\in\overline{\{y\}}$, and let $\bar x$ be a geometric point over $x$ [def-weil-geometric-point]. The canonical strict-localization morphism $X_{(\bar x)}\to X$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] has discrete fibres. Its fibre over $y$ is nonempty.

source.place: Expose XIV, Proposition 2.1.4 proof (the strict-localization map is pro-etale/flat with discrete fibres)
